title: Lesion-aware external validation and threshold transport for dermoscopic AI: reproducible software and known-truth verification
description: Version 2.2.1 adds a tested score-level evaluation tutorial for repeated lesion views, source-only threshold selection, ties, lesion-clustered uncertainty, source-threshold bootstrap reselection, identity sensitivity checks and known-truth synthetic interval coverage. The HAM10000-to-BCN20000 worked example reuses previously fitted classifier scores. No CNN is retrained. Established statistical methods are integrated in a documented executable workflow. The 120-dataset Monte Carlo results apply only to the stated data-generating conditions. Original dermoscopic images are not redistributed.
